svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 5 resources (5 cards), 8 relationships. Lines show architectural relationships. Edge titles identify the relationship kind and Terraform change. Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified.
